method: At pre-existing counter offsets, detect wide ellipse; propose red/yellow caps over white or blue ring within 2.2 fitted ring radii; patch score at least -0.7; require neutral grey-body bottom; cluster at least three frames spanning four seconds. Compare source-only wide contacts to prior overhead observations under all four sign choices. Preserve zero-output windows.
score_rule: No official diagram positions, physical throw labels, or reserved source are used. This is a five-shot coverage and orientation diagnostic, not full-video board or event F1.
limitations: Slovakia was exposed in earlier project research; only this wide-contact route is frozen.
The prior temporal artifact contains official postscore fields but the runner accesses only shot times, offsets and source-only overhead stones.
A zero wide result is a measured coverage limit, not proof of no stones.
